# Code of Conduct

## The short version

Be decent. Assume the other person is trying to help. Argue about the code,
not the person writing it.

## What is expected

This project takes contributions from people who have never opened Xcode, from
people who only want to add a website they like, and from people who write
Swift for a living. All three are welcome on the same terms:

- Give feedback about the change, not the contributor.
- Assume a report or a pull request was made in good faith, including when it
  is wrong.
- "No" is an acceptable answer, and so is "not yet". Explaining why is better
  than not explaining, but nobody owes a debate.
- English is not everyone's first language. Read past the phrasing.

## What is not acceptable

Harassment, personal attacks, insults about who someone is rather than what
they wrote, unwelcome sexual attention, publishing anyone's private
information, and deliberately derailing threads. This applies in issues, pull
requests, commit messages, and anywhere else this project is discussed.

## Reporting

Report a problem privately to the maintainer at
[@PathGao](https://github.com/PathGao). Reports are handled by one person, so
expect a human timescale rather than a process. The maintainer will read it,
respond, and may edit, hide, or delete the content in question, or block the
account, without further discussion.

Applying this document is the maintainer's job, and the maintainer is held to
it too.

## Scope

This repository, and anywhere someone is representing Nifro in public.
